summary: The PR adds a __len__ method to the Pipeline class, which resolves the issue of not being able to use len() on a Pipeline object. However, there are minor documentation and testing concerns.

issues.description: The docstring for the __len__ method could be more detailed, explaining what the length of a Pipeline represents.
While the current tests pass, adding a specific test case for the new __len__ method would improve test coverage and ensure future changes do not inadvertently break this functionality.
